text:
Noah: Quick UX review: the 'quota top-up' toast copy feels confusing when people are near their embedding quota. Need a succinct toast and SR-friendly announcement.
Priya: What's the current toast text?
Noah: Current: 'Quota refreshed. You now have more tokens.'
Omar: That's too vague. Users don't think in 'tokens' for embeddings; they look at 'quota' or 'embedding units'.
Dev: Backend returns metric 'embedding_units_remaining' so we can show a number. But toasts need to be short.
Priya: For visual toast: 'Quota updated: 1,200 embeddings remaining.'
A11yTeam: For screen readers, toasts often get skipped. Use role="status" + aria-live="polite" so SRs announce it. Also avoid punctuation that SRs read awkwardly, e.g., colons read as 'colon'.
Noah: Good point. So maybe avoid colon. Try: 'Quota updated — 1,200 embeddings remaining'.
Omar: Long dashes can be read oddly too. Keep it simple: 'Quota updated. 1,200 embeddings remaining.'
Dev: What about localization? Number formatting differs by locale (comma vs space). We'll rely on i18n formatter.
Priya: Also consider CTA: should the toast include an action like 'Manage quota' or 'Buy more'? We don't want to overload the toast. Maybe only for <200 remaining show a CTA.
DesignBot: Checklist: short clear copy, number included when available, conditional CTA under threshold, role=status and aria-live=polite, avoid confusing punctuation for SR.
A11yTeam: Add a visually-hidden sr-only prefix for SR users when critical: e.g., hidden text 'Billing notice:' or 'Quota notice:' before the message, announced immediately. But only for low quota to avoid noise.
Noah: Suggested final copy variants:
- Normal: 'Quota updated. 1,200 embeddings remaining.'
- Low-threshold (<200): Visually: 'Low quota: 180 embeddings left. Buy more.' (Buy more as button in toast)
- SR-only prefix for low: 'Quota alert: low quota. 180 embeddings remaining.'
Priya: Microcopy nit: 'Buy more' -> 'Purchase additional quota' reads a bit formal. We use 'Buy more' elsewhere in billing flows. Keep consistency: use 'Buy more' here.
Omar: Button label should be short: 'Buy more' or 'Manage quota'? 'Buy more' is direct and has clear affordance.
A11yTeam: For the 'Buy more' button, ensure aria-describedby links to the toast text so SR users get context when they tab to the button. Also keyboard focus: toast actions should be focusable and follow tabbable order but not trap focus.
Dev: Implementation notes: toast component will render role=status, aria-live=polite, inject localized number, and conditionally include button. We'll add sr-only prefix for low quota using class .sr-only.
Noah: I'll update the figma and add copy tokens:
- toast.quota.normal = 'Quota updated. {n} embeddings remaining.'
- toast.quota.low = 'Low quota: {n} embeddings remaining.'
- toast.quota.cta = 'Buy more'
Priya: Add acceptance criteria in the ticket: SR announces text on appearance, button has aria-describedby, numbers are localized, CTA only when n < 200, and no extra punctuation read oddly.
DesignBot: Also test with NVDA+Firefox and VoiceOver+iOS.
Noah: Thanks all — I'll push the copy changes and the dev PR will include the a11y hooks. :thumbsup:
